What I do

Most of my work so far has been in Unity and C#. I like gameplay systems, movement, physical inputs, and VR. I’m learning more Unreal and C++ as I go.

This is my personal site. My game development portfolio is where the more formal project work lives.

Games I love

The House in Fata Morgana, NieR, Elden Ring, and Monster Hunter. I like stories that stay with you and games that make you want to keep looking around.
